assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Sanitizing Solution02
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Provide approved sanitizing solution for food contact surfaces in labelled container. 100 ppm chlorine (2 to 3 ml of unscented bleach to 1 L of water). 200 ppm quaternary ammonium (follow label instructions).
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Will use 100 ppm bleach solution in bottles on site Will use 200 ppm Quats solution in bottles on site Will use an approved sanitizer (provide name and concentration) Will have test strips on site to verify concentration Will use sanitizer wipes (acceptance subject to Health review) Other
